scripts.//test:e2e: Auto-starts (or reuses) Vite via playwright.config.ts webServer. Fixture-mode specs (state-inspector*, etc.) need only Vite. The `e2e/smoke/` specs hit the FastAPI :8080 backend — boot Tilt or `task dev:viewer:api` first.
scripts.//test:e2e:coverage: Build prod bundle, run tests against vite preview (clean source maps), open the V8 coverage report. Backend (FastAPI :8080) must be running.
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: yarn build && (vite preview --port 4173 --host 127.0.0.1 & echo $! > /tmp/.vite-preview.pid; sleep 2; VIEWER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4173 npx playwright test; status=$?; kill $(cat /tmp/.vite-preview.pid) 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/.vite-preview.pid; exit $status)
